provenance_note: Expected booster need, floors on the mains, set pressure, boost and head, design flow of the boosted part, membrane vessel, break tank, starts per hour, annual energy, floors needing a pressure reducing valve, pressure zones and warning flags were computed by bench-src/ref/gen_plbbooster.py, an independent Python implementation written from the published method (_plb/boost/METHOD.md: EN 806-2 / DIN 1988-500 pressure balance in SI units, DIN 1988-300 peak flow, vessel found by bisection on the isothermal gas law, zones built by walking the floors top-down), not from the page code. DIN 1988-300 constants are input data from the published method. Consistency with METHOD + 8 external anchors worked by hand from the formulas of the standards (EN 806-2 / DIN 1988-500 pressure balance, also with a suction-line loss, Boyle-Mariotte vessel, DIN 1988-300 peak-flow formula incl. the utilisation-unit rule and the SHK Profi worked example 0.25 l/s, the 0.2-500 l/s curve range, DIN 1988-200 5 bar static limit with the mains night pressure, D-PLB-13); the generator refuses to write the reference unless its model reproduces the anchors. No published manufacturer worked example was available to the author.
